name: the endless wasteland: every map stands in it, the camera goes out over it, and its ground is streamed a chunk at a time

steps.note: a walled yard from before the wasteland existed: it loads standing in the default one
an endless map does not clamp the camera: twenty cells off its edge is ground, and it is drawn
a thousand cells out; every chunk round the yard is far behind and has been dropped
a dog let loose here, on dry ground near the camera: 28800 pixels up, which is past where a fixed-depth ground was drawn over the people on it

steps.shot: a thousand cells out, a dog on the ground and not under it

steps.note: and on across the world: still the size of a view, not of the trip; the first dog is far behind and not drawn
zoomed right out the view takes in more ground, so more chunks, still bounded by the canvas

steps.shot: zoomed out over the wasteland: dirt, scrub, meadow and lakes

steps.note: a second dog, 144000 pixels down: past the 1000 of depth a default 2D camera sees, where it was clipped away

steps.shot: a dog out in the wasteland, drawn

steps.note: the editor draws the wasteland too, dimmed: the bright part is the map that can be painted

steps.shot: the editor: the yard bright, the wasteland round it dimmed
